recent_posts: The Djiboutian franc trades at 177.7 per dollar, virtually unchanged over the week. It has moved within a tight 1.0% band over the past year, and has not seen a move of 0.25% in five days. #Djibouti $DJF

The Pakistani rupee stands stable at 277.6 to the dollar, with no significant change over the past week. It has not moved by more than 0.25% in eleven days, and it is 2.3% better than its weakest point of the year. #Pakistan $PKR
The kyat stands at 2,100 to the dollar, its weakest point in a year. It has gone 752 days without a move exceeding 0.25%. #Myanmar $MMK

The kina has slipped to 4.46 per dollar, its weakest level since tracking began in early 2024. It's down 8.05% from a year ago, and the five sources fixing the rate today disagree by 3.63%, well above its usual 1.29% spread. #PapuaNewGuinea $PGK
